items.example_zh: 她整晚沒睡，陪伴生病的孩子。

items.example_zh: 我們必須立即採取行動滅火。

items.example_zh: 她已準備好接受新的挑戰。

items.example_en: Our team leads by three points.
items.example_zh: 我們隊領先三分。

items.example_en: The customer was satisfied with the service.
items.example_zh: 顧客對服務感到滿意。

items.example_en: Her parents are proud of her.

items.example_en: Joining a club helped him get rid of loneliness.
items.example_zh: 加入社團幫助他擺脫孤獨。

items.example_zh: 那位資淺員工問了許多問題。

points.title:
S + find/consider/feel/think... + it + adj./N + to + VR 
it 作虛受詞+受詞補語+ to do作真正受詞
examples: Many fans think it a great achievement to win three championships.
Most parents feel it unacceptable to leave young children at home alone.

points.title:
It seems that…/It appears that…
it 作虛主詞；that子句為真正主詞置後
examples: It seems that he is not feeling well.
It appeared that she was satisfied with her performance.

text_genre.raw_text:
A dynamic character graphic organizer
A dynamic character is someone who changes significantly inside as a story unfolds. They learn important lessons, grow emotionally, or alter their way of thinking because of the experiences and challenges they face.   “The Day I Broke the Rule” is a narrative depicting the changes “I” experienced, with the turning point being the sick boy Billy asking for a hug, which was against the rule due to hygiene concerns. “I” broke the rule by giving Billy a hug, as nothing could convey love, empathy, and warmth like a heartfelt embrace. It follows the structure below: 
Character at the Beginning: what I did; what I knew; how I felt
Turning point:  Billy asked if he could get a hug
Character at the End: what I did; what I knew; how I felt
